Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two outfit suggestions using your new graphic tee and pieces from your wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Streetwear
* **Top:** Graphic Tee — 2003 Tour Bootleg Style
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
* **Shoes:** Black combat boots
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag

**Styling:** Wear the graphic tee tucked loosely into the baggy dark wash jeans. Layer the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top, and finish with the black combat boots and black crossbody bag for an effortless, grungy streetwear look.

---

### Outfit 2: Contrast Casual
* **Top:** Graphic Tee — 2003 Tour Bootleg Style
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers
* **Bag:** Black crossbody bag

**Styling:** Tuck the boxy graphic tee into the wide-leg khaki trousers, secured with the brown leather belt to add structure and a touch of earth tones. Pair with the chunky white sneakers and the black crossbody bag for a casual high-low contrast between minimal trousers and a vintage band tee.
```

    "outfit_suggestion": "**Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Streetwear**\n*   **Top:** Graphic Tee \u2014 2003 Tour Bootleg Style\n*   **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash\n*   **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket\n*   **Shoes:** Black combat boots\n*   **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag\n\n**Styling:** Tuck or leave the boxy graphic tee untucked over the high-waisted baggy jeans for an effortless, slouchy silhouette. Layer the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top and finish with the black combat boots and black crossbody bag for a cohesive, grunge-inspired monochrome look.\n\n---\n\n**Outfit 2: Casual Contrast**\n*   **Top:** Graphic Tee \u2014 2003 Tour Bootleg Style\n*   **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers\n*   **Accessories:** Brown leather belt, Black crossbody bag\n*   **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers\n\n**Styling:** Tuck the black graphic tee into the wide-leg khaki trousers and accent the waist with the brown leather belt to balance the proportions. The light-wash denim pops against the monochrome black-and-white base, creating effortless streetwear contrast.\n\n### Outfit 2: Casual Vintage Prep (Daytime Chic)\n* **Silhouette:** Fitted layers paired with an A-line midi skirt for a play on proportions.\n* **The Pieces:** Layer the jacket over a fine-knit black crewneck sweater, paired with an olive green or plaid pleated midi skirt.\n* **Shoes:** Classic canvas low-top sneakers (like Converse All Stars) or black leather loafers with white crew socks.\n* **Accessories:** A tortoiseshell claw clip and a structured brown leather shoulder bag.\n* **Why it works:** The structured shoulders of the vintage jacket add sharp lines that elevate a simple skirt-and-sweater combo. Outfit suggestion:

```
### Outfit 1: Streetwear Edge (Casual & Modern)
* **Silhouette:** Boxy top balanced with a high-waisted, relaxed bottom.
* **The Pieces:** Pair the cropped jacket over a fitted white ribbed tank top, paired with black wide-leg cargo trousers. 
* **Shoes:** Chunky retro sneakers (like Nike Air Force 1s or New Balance 550s) in white/grey.
* **Accessories:** A minimalist black nylon cross-body bag and silver hoop earrings.
* **Why it works:** The cropped cut of the jacket naturally accentuates the waist, making it the ideal counterpart to voluminous cargo pants. The light-wash denim pops against the monochrome black-and-white base, creating effortless streetwear contrast.

### Outfit 2: Casual Vintage Prep (Daytime Chic)
* **Silhouette:** Fitted layers paired with an A-line midi skirt for a play on proportions.
* **The Pieces:** Layer the jacket over a fine-knit black crewneck sweater, paired with an olive green or plaid pleated midi skirt.
* **Shoes:** Classic canvas low-top sneakers (like Converse All Stars) or black leather loafers with white crew socks.
* **Accessories:** A tortoiseshell claw clip and a structured brown leather shoulder bag.
* **Why it works:** The structured shoulders of the vintage jacket add sharp lines that elevate a simple skirt-and-sweater combo. The light blue wash softens the heavier fall tones (olive and black), resulting in a balanced transitional look.
```

        "outfit": "**Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear**\n* **The Look:** Pair the cropped light wash denim jacket with a fitted black ribbed mock-neck tank top and high-waisted, wide-leg olive green cargo trousers. \n* **Shoes & Accessories:** Chunky white leather sneakers and a minimalist black nylon crossbody bag. \n* **Why it works:** The cropped cut of the jacket naturally pairs with high-waisted bottoms to elongate your legs, while the structured shoulders balance the volume of the wide-leg cargo pants. \n\n**Outfit 2: Elevated Off-Duty**\n* **The Look:** Layer the jacket over a simple white cotton baby tee tucked into a black midi-length slip skirt in satin or silk.\n* **Shoes & Accessories:** Black leather loafers with white crew socks and delicate silver hoop earrings.\n* **Why it works:** This outfit plays with contrasting textures\u2014the rugged, structured denim balances the fluid, feminine drape of the silk slip skirt for an effortless high-low mix.",

Outfit suggestion:

```
**Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear**
* **The Look:** Pair the cropped light wash denim jacket with a fitted black ribbed mock-neck tank top and high-waisted, wide-leg olive green cargo trousers. 
* **Shoes & Accessories:** Chunky white leather sneakers and a minimalist black nylon crossbody bag. 
* **Why it works:** The cropped cut of the jacket naturally pairs with high-waisted bottoms to elongate your legs, while the structured shoulders balance the volume of the wide-leg cargo pants. 

**Outfit 2: Elevated Off-Duty**
* **The Look:** Layer the jacket over a simple white cotton baby tee tucked into a black midi-length slip skirt in satin or silk.
* **Shoes & Accessories:** Black leather loafers with white crew socks and delicate silver hoop earrings.
* **Why it works:** This outfit plays with contrasting textures—the rugged, structured denim balances the fluid, feminine drape of the silk slip skirt for an effortless high-low mix.
```

Outfit suggestion:

```
**Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear**
* **The Look:** Pair the cropped light wash denim jacket with high-waisted, wide-leg black cargo trousers and a fitted ribbed white tank top. 
* **Shoes & Accessories:** Finish with retro canvas sneakers (like Converse or Adidas Sambas), a black leather crossbody bag, and chunky silver hoop earrings.
* **Why it works:** The cropped cut of the jacket balances the volume of the wide-leg pants by naturally hitting at the waist. The stark contrast between the light blue wash, black trousers, and white tank creates an effortlessly cool, balanced color palette.

**Outfit 2: Elevated Casual**
* **The Look:** Layer the jacket over a slip midi dress in an olive green or floral print, adding contrast to the feminine silhouette.
* **Shoes & Accessories:** Pair with black leather ankle boots and a minimalist structured shoulder bag. 
* **Why it works:** The structured shoulders and casual vibe of the denim jacket ground the delicate nature of a slip dress, creating a high-low mix that feels modern and intentional.

    "outfit_suggestion": "**Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear**\n* **The Look:** Pair the cropped light wash denim jacket with high-waisted, wide-leg black trousers and a fitted, ribbed white crewneck tank top. \n* **Why it works:** The cropped length of the jacket naturally accentuates the waist when paired with high-waisted bottoms, while the contrast between the light wash denim and dark trousers creates a sharp, balanced silhouette. \n* **Shoes & Accessories:** Finish with retro white leather sneakers (like Adidas Sambas) and a minimalist black leather crossbody bag to tie the streetwear aesthetic together.\n\n**Outfit 2: Elevated Off-Duty**\n* **The Look:** Layer the jacket over a midi-length, slip-style black midi dress in satin or ribbed knit. \n* **Why it works:** The structured shoulders and casual vibe of the denim jacket dress down the sleekness of the slip dress, creating an effortless high-low balance.\n* **Shoes & Accessories:** Add black leather ankle boots and layered silver pendant necklaces to complement the cool tones of the light wash denim.",

Outfit suggestion:

```
**Outfit 1: Casual Streetwear**
* **The Look:** Pair the cropped light wash denim jacket with high-waisted, wide-leg black trousers and a fitted, ribbed white crewneck tank top. 
* **Why it works:** The cropped length of the jacket naturally accentuates the waist when paired with high-waisted bottoms, while the contrast between the light wash denim and dark trousers creates a sharp, balanced silhouette. 
* **Shoes & Accessories:** Finish with retro white leather sneakers (like Adidas Sambas) and a minimalist black leather crossbody bag to tie the streetwear aesthetic together.

**Outfit 2: Elevated Off-Duty**
* **The Look:** Layer the jacket over a midi-length, slip-style black midi dress in satin or ribbed knit. 
* **Why it works:** The structured shoulders and casual vibe of the denim jacket dress down the sleekness of the slip dress, creating an effortless high-low balance.
* **Shoes & Accessories:** Add black leather ankle boots and layered silver pendant necklaces to complement the cool tones of the light wash denim.
```

**Outfit 1: Y2K Grunge Streetwear**

* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash

**Outfit 2: Casual Contrast**

Outfit suggestion:

```
Here are two practical outfit suggestions using the Graphic Tee and pieces from your wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Streetwear
* **Top:** Graphic Tee — 2003 Tour Bootleg Style
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket
* **Shoes:** Black combat boots
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag

**Styling:** Tuck the slightly boxy graphic tee loosely into the high-waisted dark baggy jeans. Layer the vintage black denim jacket on top, finish with the black combat boots for a classic grunge look, and sling the black crossbody bag over your shoulder.

### Outfit 2: Casual Contrast Streetwear
* **Top:** Graphic Tee — 2003 Tour Bootleg Style
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers
* **Outerwear:** Black cropped zip hoodie (worn open)
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt, Black crossbody bag

**Styling:** Wear the graphic tee untucked over the wide-leg khaki trousers, cinched with the brown leather belt. Layer the black cropped zip hoodie unzipped over the tee to play with proportions, and tie the look together with the chunky white sneakers and black crossbody bag.

Here are two outfit ideas using your new Graphic Tee and pieces from your wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: 90s Grunge Streetwear
* **New item:** Graphic Tee — 2003 Tour Bootleg Style
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
* **Shoes:** Black combat boots
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag
* **Styling:** Tuck the boxy graphic tee loosely into the high-waisted baggy dark-wash jeans. Pair with black combat boots to lean into the grunge aesthetic, and finish with the black crossbody bag for an effortless everyday look.

### Outfit 2: Layered Vintage Edge
* **New item:** Graphic Tee — 2003 Tour Bootleg Style
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt, Black crossbody bag
* **Styling:** Wear the graphic tee untucked over the wide-leg khaki trousers, secured with the brown leather belt. Layer the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top to play with proportions against the wide legs, and complete the fit with chunky white sneakers and the black crossbody bag.

Here are two outfit suggestions using the Y2K Butterfly Print Baby Tee and your existing wardrobe:

**Outfit 1: Y2K Streetwear**

*   **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket

Throw on the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket and chunky white sneakers to complete an effortless, mixed-style look.

    "outfit_suggestion": "Here are two outfit suggestions using the new Y2K baby tee and pieces from your wardrobe:\n\n### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear\n* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee \u2014 Butterfly Print\n* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash\n* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket\n* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers\n* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag\n\n**Styling:** Tuck the fitted, cropped butterfly tee into your high-waisted baggy jeans to highlight the waist against the relaxed denim. Layer the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top, and finish the look with chunky white sneakers and the black crossbody bag for an effortless early 2000s streetwear vibe.\n\n---\n\n### Outfit 2: Contrast Minimal/Y2K Mix\n* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee \u2014 Butterfly Print\n* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers\n* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt, black crossbody bag\n* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers\n\n**Styling:** Pair the pink, purple, and white graphic baby tee with your minimal wide-leg khaki trousers to ground the playful Y2K print with neutral earth tones. ```
Here are two outfit suggestions using the new Y2K baby tee and pieces from your wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash
* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers
* **Accessories:** Black crossbody bag

**Styling:** Tuck the fitted, cropped butterfly tee into your high-waisted baggy jeans to highlight the waist against the relaxed denim. Layer the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top, and finish the look with chunky white sneakers and the black crossbody bag for an effortless early 2000s streetwear vibe.

---

### Outfit 2: Contrast Minimal/Y2K Mix
* **Top:** Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers
* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt, black crossbody bag
* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers

**Styling:** Pair the pink, purple, and white graphic baby tee with your minimal wide-leg khaki trousers to ground the playful Y2K print with neutral earth tones. Thread the brown leather belt through the trousers to pull the look together, and step into chunky white sneakers to keep the overall silhouette balanced and casual.

Finish with chunky white sneakers and the black crossbody bag for an effortless, authentic early-2000s streetwear look.\n\n**Outfit 2: Casual Edge**\n* **Outerwear:** Vintage black denim jacket\n* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers\n* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers\n* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt\n* **Styling:** Pair the pink and purple butterfly baby tee with the wide-leg khaki trousers, cinched at the waist with the brown leather belt. Layer the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top and step into the chunky white sneakers for a relaxed outfit that plays on earth tones and Y2K vintage style.",

Layer the slightly cropped vintage black denim jacket on top, and finish the look with chunky white sneakers and the black crossbody bag for an effortless early 2000s streetwear vibe.\n\n---\n\n### Outfit 2: Casual Contrast\n* **Bottoms:** Wide-leg khaki trousers\n* **Accessories:** Brown leather belt, Black crossbody bag\n* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers\n\n**Styling:** Pair the pink-and-purple butterfly baby tee with the minimal wide-leg khaki trousers. Cinch the trousers with the brown leather belt to add structure at the waist, and keep the footwear casual with the chunky white sneakers. Wear the black crossbody bag to tie the look together.",

Here are two outfit suggestions using the new Y2K baby tee and pieces from your wardrobe:

### Outfit 1: Classic Y2K Streetwear
* **Bottoms:** Baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash

---

### Outfit 2: Casual Contrast

* **Shoes:** Chunky white sneakers
